description: Dependency-ordered business migrations for the light rail maintenance system.

migrations.verifySql: SELECT to_regclass('public.user_session') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='app_user' AND column_name='account') AS ok
